newsitem.title: INDIA: Interest on India floating rate bond set at 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Interest on India floating rate bond set at 13 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday it had set the rate of interest on the floating rate bonds maturing in 1999 at 13 percent per annum for the half-year ending September 1997.

The bonds had been issued with a clause that interest would be set at 1.25 percent over the average rate of the implicit cut-off yields at the 364-day treasury bill auctions held in the preceding half-year.
"The average rate of the implicit yields at cut-off prices of 364-day treasury bill auctions held during the half-year ending February 1997 is 10.92 percent," the RBI said in a statement.
"Accordingly, the rate of interest on floating rate bonds, 1999, applicable for half-year ending September 29, 1997 shall be 13 percent."
